summary: Seat lanes, step 1: an agent (top-level or in a mission) may declare `capacity cores=N memory="SIZE"`. On a Linux host whose config sets `lanes = "on"`, that seat gets a slice of its own, app.slice/app-lanes.slice/app-lanes-<seat>_<digest>.slice, capped with CPUQuota, MemoryMax, MemorySwapMax (a quarter of the memory) and TasksMax; each launch of its harness is a scope in it with OOMPolicy=continue. A job the seat starts as its own unit in the slice ($FRACTAL_LANE_SLICE) outlives a restart of the harness; the slice ends when the seat stops for good. Builds stay inside (BUILDS_SLICE_ACTIVE and a seat-private sccache socket; scripts/st-test runs a check in place only inside builds.slice or a seat's lane slice holding a memory and a CPU limit). Seats without a declaration, and every seat on a host with the switch off, run as before.

replay.detail: No claim, event or replay change; the member record gains an optional field.

schema.detail: MemberSpec gains optional `capacity` (omitted when absent, so existing records and revisions are unchanged); the install config gains optional `lanes` (on|off).

rules.detail: The agent declaration accepts a `capacity` child (cores=, memory=), at most once; it is refused with bind-terminal.

compatibility.detail: An older member reading a laned record drops the field and runs the seat without a lane. An older CLI refuses a file that declares `capacity`; an older daemon refuses a config that sets `lanes` (deny_unknown_fields), so set it only on hosts that run this build.

downtime.detail: Nothing changes until a host sets `lanes = "on"` and a seat declares `capacity`; a lane applies at the seat's next start.

manual.detail: Before a host turns lanes on, its admission guard must count only OOM kills outside lanes: oom_kill(user-UID.slice) minus oom_kill(app.slice/app-lanes.slice) (docs/st3/seat-lanes.md, The host guard). Operations has been asked.

recovery.detail: Before downgrading a host to a build without lanes, remove `lanes` from its config.toml: an older daemon refuses a config that contains it (deny_unknown_fields) and does not start. To turn lanes off without a downgrade, set `lanes = "off"` (or remove it) and restart the daemon; laned seats run without a lane from their next start. A lane left from before (app-lanes-<seat>_<digest>.slice) ends with `systemctl --user stop` and `revert` on it.
